name: jobs-drain-next
title: Jobs drain cron route (Next.js)
description: lib/jobs.ts and app/api/jobs/drain/route.ts: the queues and the cron route that runs schedules and drains them.
docs: Needs the jobs block with the drain scheduler: `npx better-supabase add jobs`, with `scheduler: "drain"` in its options. Schedule it with `{ "crons": [{ "path": "/api/jobs/drain", "schedule": "* * * * *" }] }` in `vercel.json`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/jobs#drain-route.
